name: smwmusic-super-mario-3d-land-toad-house
title: Super Mario 3D Land - Toad House
description:
Toad House theme from Super Mario 3D Land, originally form Super Mario Bros. 3 where it was both Toad House and P-switch theme. Could fit as a P-switch theme or maybe a bonus area theme.

Updated:
Included a version with tuned down xylophone.

Also, if you want a version that sounds like when you're otside of the Toad House in SM3DL, you can just disable channels 1 to 3.
